# Maison Maxine

> Maison Maxine is a Napa Valley red wine spritz brand. Its Red Wine Spritz is Cabernet Sauvignon with ginger, lemon and honey, lightly sparkling, 5% ABV, in 250 mL cans, and certified organic by CCOF. 21+ only.

## Key facts

- Product: Maison Maxine Red Wine Spritz, a carbonated red wine spritz in cans
- Wine: Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
- Ingredients: Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon, natural ginger flavoring, lemon, honey (four ingredients; no refined sugar)
- Alcohol: 5% ABV
- Can size: 250 mL (8.4 fl oz)
- Certification: certified organic by CCOF (California Certified Organic Farmers)
- Online prices: 8 cans in 2 gift boxes, $56; case of 24 cans in 6 gift boxes, $144
- Shipping: to 36 U.S. states and Washington, D.C., via UPS from Los Angeles; free over $100 (the case always ships free), otherwise $7; ships in 1 to 2 business days, arrives in 3 to 5
- Age: 21+ only; birthday checked at checkout; an adult 21+ signs for every delivery
- Stockists: 17 shops in Southern California, New York City and the Hamptons
- Giving back: 5% of every order goes to animal rescue
- Contact: Instagram @maisonmaxine.world
